name: Smart Warehouse Omniverse USD
description: Generates an OpenUSD scene-building Python script for NVIDIA Isaac Sim from the Smart Warehouse model. MobileRobot elements use a vendored CC0 referenced asset when an asset root is supplied; other classes and missing assets use placeholder USD geometry.

templates.name: Generate Omniverse USD Scene
templates.templateContent:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Generated from a SpatialDSL Studio Smart Warehouse model.

Run with the NVIDIA Isaac Sim Python environment:
  ./python.sh generate_warehouse_usd.py /absolute/path/warehouse_scene.usda /absolute/path/examples/omniverse-assets

On Windows, use python.bat instead of python.sh.

This generator resolves each element's asset through a versioned asset
manifest (asset-manifest.json under the asset root when available, otherwise
an embedded default), with per-element overrides taking priority over
per-class defaults. Unmapped classes or missing asset files fall back to
placeholder geometry. Physics and robot simulation behavior remain separate
future layers.
"""

from pathlib import Path
import json
import re
import sys

try:
    from pxr import Gf, Sdf, Usd, UsdGeom, UsdLux
except ModuleNotFoundError as exc:
    raise SystemExit(
        "Could not import pxr. Run this script with Isaac Sim "
        "Python, for example: ./python.sh generate_warehouse_usd.py"
    ) from exc


ELEMENTS = [
{{resetListComma "omniverseElements"}}
{{#each elementsByClassName.PathwayArea}}{{commaIfNeeded "omniverseElements"}}
    {
        "name": "{{name}}",
        "class_name": "PathwayArea",
        "x_mm": {{X}},
        "y_mm": {{Y}},
        "rz_deg": {{#unless RZ}}0{{else}}{{RZ}}{{/unless}},
        "length_mm": {{Length}},
        "width_mm": {{Width}},
        "height_mm": {{Height}},
        "color": (0.68, 0.72, 0.76),
    }
{{/each}}
{{#each elementsByClassName.Conveyor}}{{commaIfNeeded "omniverseElements"}}
    {
        "name": "{{name}}",
        "class_name": "Conveyor",
        "x_mm": {{X}},
        "y_mm": {{Y}},
        "rz_deg": {{#unless RZ}}0{{else}}{{RZ}}{{/unless}},
        "length_mm": {{Length}},
        "width_mm": {{Width}},
        "height_mm": {{Height}},
        "color": (0.18, 0.36, 0.74),
    }
{{/each}}
{{#each elementsByClassName.OutputLocation}}{{commaIfNeeded "omniverseElements"}}
    {
        "name": "{{name}}",
        "class_name": "OutputLocation",
        "x_mm": {{X}},
        "y_mm": {{Y}},
        "rz_deg": {{#unless RZ}}0{{else}}{{RZ}}{{/unless}},
        "length_mm": {{Length}},
        "width_mm": {{Width}},
        "height_mm": {{Height}},
        "color": (0.15, 0.60, 0.42),
    }
{{/each}}
{{#each elementsByClassName.ChargingStation}}{{commaIfNeeded "omniverseElements"}}
    {
        "name": "{{name}}",
        "class_name": "ChargingStation",
        "x_mm": {{X}},
        "y_mm": {{Y}},
        "rz_deg": {{#unless RZ}}0{{else}}{{RZ}}{{/unless}},
        "length_mm": {{Length}},
        "width_mm": {{Width}},
        "height_mm": {{Height}},
        "color": (0.96, 0.72, 0.20),
    }
{{/each}}
{{#each elementsByClassName.MobileRobot}}{{commaIfNeeded "omniverseElements"}}
    {
        "name": "{{name}}",
        "class_name": "MobileRobot",
        "x_mm": {{X}},
        "y_mm": {{Y}},
        "rz_deg": {{#unless RZ}}0{{else}}{{RZ}}{{/unless}},
        "length_mm": {{Length}},
        "width_mm": {{Width}},
        "height_mm": {{Height}},
        "color": (0.84, 0.20, 0.18),
    }
{{/each}}
{{#each elementsByClassName.StorageRack}}{{commaIfNeeded "omniverseElements"}}
    {
        "name": "{{name}}",
        "class_name": "StorageRack",
        "x_mm": {{X}},
        "y_mm": {{Y}},
        "rz_deg": {{#unless RZ}}0{{else}}{{RZ}}{{/unless}},
        "length_mm": {{Length}},
        "width_mm": {{Width}},
        "height_mm": {{Height}},
        "color": (0.55, 0.45, 0.30),
    }
{{/each}}
{{#each elementsByClassName.Dock}}{{commaIfNeeded "omniverseElements"}}
    {
        "name": "{{name}}",
        "class_name": "Dock",
        "x_mm": {{X}},
        "y_mm": {{Y}},
        "rz_deg": {{#unless RZ}}0{{else}}{{RZ}}{{/unless}},
        "length_mm": {{Length}},
        "width_mm": {{Width}},
        "height_mm": {{Height}},
        "color": (0.40, 0.45, 0.55),
    }
{{/each}}
]

ASSET_MAP = {
    "MobileRobot": {
        "asset": "cc0-mini-vehicle-kit/demo_forklift.usda",
        "uniformScale": 0.01,
        "rotateXDeg": 90.0,
        "zOffsetM": 0.0,
    },
    "Conveyor": {
        "asset": "warehouse-kit/conveyor.usda",
        "scaleMode": "fit",
    },
    "ChargingStation": {
        "asset": "warehouse-kit/charging_station.usda",
        "scaleMode": "fit",
    },
    "OutputLocation": {
        "asset": "warehouse-kit/output_location.usda",
        "scaleMode": "fit",
    },
    "PathwayArea": {
        "asset": "warehouse-kit/pathway_area.usda",
        "scaleMode": "fit",
    },
    "StorageRack": {
        "asset": "warehouse-kit/storage_rack.usda",
        "scaleMode": "fit",
    },
    "Dock": {
        "asset": "warehouse-kit/dock.usda",
        "scaleMode": "fit",
    },
}

EMBEDDED_ASSET_MANIFEST = {
    "version": 1,
    "defaults": ASSET_MAP,
    "overrides": {},
}


def load_asset_manifest(asset_root):
    manifest_path = Path(asset_root) / "asset-manifest.json"
    try:
        with open(manifest_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            manifest = json.load(handle)
        if isinstance(manifest, dict) and isinstance(manifest.get("defaults"), dict):
            manifest.setdefault("overrides", {})
            return manifest
        print(f"[asset] WARNING: {manifest_path} is not a valid asset manifest; using embedded defaults")
    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
        print(f"[asset] WARNING: could not load {manifest_path} ({exc}); using embedded defaults")
    return EMBEDDED_ASSET_MANIFEST


def resolve_asset_for_element(manifest, class_name, element_name):
    overrides = manifest.get("overrides") or {}
    defaults = manifest.get("defaults") or {}
    if element_name in overrides:
        return overrides[element_name]
    return defaults.get(class_name)


def mm_to_m(value):
    return float(value) / 1000.0


def clean_prim_name(value):
    cleaned = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", value.strip())
    cleaned = re.sub(r"_+", "_", cleaned).strip("_")
    if not cleaned:
        cleaned = "Element"
    if cleaned[0].isdigit():
        cleaned = "_" + cleaned
    return cleaned


def unique_path(base_path, used_paths):
    candidate = base_path
    index = 2
    while candidate in used_paths:
        candidate = base_path + "_" + str(index)
        index += 1
    used_paths.add(candidate)
    return candidate


def set_source_metadata(prim, element):
    prim.CreateAttribute("spatialDsl:sourceName", Sdf.ValueTypeNames.String).Set(element["name"])
    prim.CreateAttribute("spatialDsl:className", Sdf.ValueTypeNames.String).Set(element["class_name"])
    prim.CreateAttribute("spatialDsl:xMm", Sdf.ValueTypeNames.Double).Set(float(element["x_mm"]))
    prim.CreateAttribute("spatialDsl:yMm", Sdf.ValueTypeNames.Double).Set(float(element["y_mm"]))
    prim.CreateAttribute("spatialDsl:rotationZDeg", Sdf.ValueTypeNames.Double).Set(float(element["rz_deg"]))


def add_box(stage, path, element):
    length_m = max(mm_to_m(element["length_mm"]), 0.001)
    width_m = max(mm_to_m(element["width_mm"]), 0.001)
    height_m = max(mm_to_m(element["height_mm"]), 0.001)
    x_m = mm_to_m(element["x_mm"])
    y_m = mm_to_m(element["y_mm"])

    cube = UsdGeom.Cube.Define(stage, path)
    cube.CreateSizeAttr(1.0)
    cube.CreateDisplayColorAttr([Gf.Vec3f(*element["color"])])

    xformable = UsdGeom.Xformable(cube.GetPrim())
    xformable.AddTranslateOp().Set(Gf.Vec3d(x_m, y_m, height_m / 2.0))
    xformable.AddRotateZOp().Set(float(element["rz_deg"]))
    xformable.AddScaleOp().Set(Gf.Vec3f(length_m, width_m, height_m))

    set_source_metadata(cube.GetPrim(), element)
    return cube


def add_referenced_asset(stage, path, element, asset_root, manifest):
    asset_config = resolve_asset_for_element(manifest, element["class_name"], element["name"])
    if not asset_config:
        print(f"[asset] WARNING: no asset for {element['name']} ({element['class_name']}); using cube fallback")
        return False

    asset_path = (asset_root / asset_config["asset"]).resolve()
    if not asset_path.is_file():
        print("Asset not found; using placeholder: " + str(asset_path))
        return False

    asset = UsdGeom.Xform.Define(stage, path)
    prim = asset.GetPrim()
    prim.GetReferences().AddReference(str(asset_path))
    prim.SetInstanceable(True)

    x_m = mm_to_m(element["x_mm"])
    y_m = mm_to_m(element["y_mm"])
    z_offset = float(asset_config.get("zOffsetM", 0.0))
    xformable = UsdGeom.Xformable(prim)

    if asset_config.get("scaleMode") == "fit":
        # Fit the referenced asset (authored as a 1 m unit box) to the element's
        # modelled dimensions, matching how the cube fallback is sized.
        length_m = max(mm_to_m(element["length_mm"]), 0.001)
        width_m = max(mm_to_m(element["width_mm"]), 0.001)
        height_m = max(mm_to_m(element["height_mm"]), 0.001)
        xformable.AddTranslateOp().Set(Gf.Vec3d(x_m, y_m, height_m / 2.0 + z_offset))
        xformable.AddRotateZOp().Set(float(element["rz_deg"]))
        xformable.AddScaleOp().Set(Gf.Vec3f(length_m, width_m, height_m))
    else:
        xformable.AddTranslateOp().Set(Gf.Vec3d(x_m, y_m, z_offset))
        xformable.AddRotateZOp().Set(float(element["rz_deg"]))
        xformable.AddRotateXOp().Set(float(asset_config.get("rotateXDeg", 0.0)))
        scale = float(asset_config.get("uniformScale", 1.0))
        xformable.AddScaleOp().Set(Gf.Vec3f(scale, scale, scale))

    set_source_metadata(prim, element)
    prim.CreateAttribute("spatialDsl:assetPath", Sdf.ValueTypeNames.String).Set(str(asset_path))
    return True

def add_floor(stage):
    if not ELEMENTS:
        return

    min_x = min(mm_to_m(e["x_mm"]) - mm_to_m(e["length_mm"]) / 2.0 for e in ELEMENTS)
    max_x = max(mm_to_m(e["x_mm"]) + mm_to_m(e["length_mm"]) / 2.0 for e in ELEMENTS)
    min_y = min(mm_to_m(e["y_mm"]) - mm_to_m(e["width_mm"]) / 2.0 for e in ELEMENTS)
    max_y = max(mm_to_m(e["y_mm"]) + mm_to_m(e["width_mm"]) / 2.0 for e in ELEMENTS)

    margin_m = 3.0
    center_x = (min_x + max_x) / 2.0
    center_y = (min_y + max_y) / 2.0
    size_x = (max_x - min_x) + margin_m * 2.0
    size_y = (max_y - min_y) + margin_m * 2.0

    floor = UsdGeom.Cube.Define(stage, "/World/Floor")
    floor.CreateSizeAttr(1.0)
    floor.CreateDisplayColorAttr([Gf.Vec3f(0.20, 0.22, 0.24)])

    xformable = UsdGeom.Xformable(floor.GetPrim())
    xformable.AddTranslateOp().Set(Gf.Vec3d(center_x, center_y, -0.055))
    xformable.AddScaleOp().Set(Gf.Vec3f(size_x, size_y, 0.10))


def add_lighting(stage):
    light = UsdLux.DistantLight.Define(stage, "/World/Sun")
    light.CreateIntensityAttr(500.0)
    UsdGeom.Xformable(light.GetPrim()).AddRotateXYZOp().Set(Gf.Vec3f(-55.0, 0.0, 35.0))


def create_scene(output_path, asset_root=None):
    output_path = Path(output_path).expanduser().resolve()
    asset_root = (
        Path(asset_root).expanduser().resolve()
        if asset_root
        else (Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "omniverse-assets").resolve()
    )
    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    stage = Usd.Stage.CreateNew(str(output_path))
    UsdGeom.SetStageUpAxis(stage, UsdGeom.Tokens.z)
    UsdGeom.SetStageMetersPerUnit(stage, 1.0)

    world = UsdGeom.Xform.Define(stage, "/World")
    stage.SetDefaultPrim(world.GetPrim())

    add_floor(stage)
    manifest = load_asset_manifest(asset_root)
    used_paths = set()
    referenced_asset_count = 0
    for element in ELEMENTS:
        UsdGeom.Xform.Define(stage, "/World/" + element["class_name"])
        base_path = "/World/" + element["class_name"] + "/" + clean_prim_name(element["name"])
        path = unique_path(base_path, used_paths)
        if add_referenced_asset(stage, path, element, asset_root, manifest):
            referenced_asset_count += 1
        else:
            add_box(stage, path, element)

    add_lighting(stage)
    stage.GetRootLayer().Save()

    print("Generated USD scene: " + str(output_path))
    print("Elements: " + str(len(ELEMENTS)))
    print("Referenced assets: " + str(referenced_asset_count))
    return output_path


if __name__ == "__main__":
    target = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "warehouse_scene.usda"
    assets = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else None
    create_scene(target, assets)
